summary: The historical v20 evaluation first diverged in RNG at step 82 because the JS take-out path did not resume icebox timers. A101 now wires out_container to removed_from_icebox; a fresh source-range replay matches the admitted case through zero-based step 82, including start_corpse_timeout. Independent #tip runtime also fully matches. The separate active monster MUSE_BAG removal caller remains unverified; its retained blocked recipe reaches find_misc with rn2(5)=1 before dog_invent drops the box.

source.branch: out_container() has passed its artifact, fatal-corpse and lift checks, split the selected stack if needed, extracted the selected object and recalculated the container weight. When gc.current_container is an ICE_BOX, it must call removed_from_icebox() before floor-container billing, pick_pick(), addinv(), and inventory feedback. For a corpse whose age is absolute, removed_from_icebox() computes svm.moves - obj->age, obtains OMONST traits with get_mtraits(obj, FALSE), sets norevive according to whether the saved or base species is an ice troll, then calls start_corpse_timeout().
callers: pickup.c:menu_loot calls out_container for manual/autopick take-out; pickup.c:traditional_loot passes it as the askchain callback.
pickup.c:tipcontainer calls removed_from_icebox while extracting ICE_BOX contents.
mon.c:meatbox calls removed_from_icebox, but source material/consumer gates prevent ICE_BOX from reaching meatbox through valid production callers.
muse.c:mloot_container calls removed_from_icebox after an ICE_BOX item passes can_carry; its runtime entry remains blocked by find_misc selection.
dependencies: include/obj.h:age_is_relative is a macro that keeps the six relative-age object kinds unchanged.
mkobj.c:get_mtraits, start_corpse_timeout and start_glob_timeout are existing complete implementations; the last two contain timer RNG/state behavior consumed by this impure helper.
ICE_BOX is TOOL_CLASS and PLASTIC (objects.h:903–904); is_organic/is_metallic material thresholds and all direct m_consume_obj consumers show the meatbox ICE_BOX arm is not production-reachable.
The active mloot_container route remains unverified: the committed blocked recipe reaches find_misc at muse.c:2235 but rn2(5)=1 prevents MUSE_BAG selection.

evidence: Historical evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261005201650-v20.json at c976c27ef3f988a4f139c5f4a2b440f6f3d41123 recorded its first RNG mismatch at segment 0, step 82: rn2(1000)=876 from mkobj.c:start_corpse_timeout. Evaluation metrics are retained as provenance, not current-code parity.

Fresh current-code source-range validation in A101 matched the admitted case through zero-based step 82. C reaches pickup.c:menu_loot -> out_container, extracts the selected ice-troll corpse from the carried ICE_BOX, and calls removed_from_icebox -> start_corpse_timeout during that boundary.

Independent recipe recipes/pickup.c/a101-tip-icebox-corpse-complete.session.json and recording recordings/pickup.c/a101-tip-icebox-corpse-complete.session.json strictly match: step 74 chooses the floor target and runs three start_corpse_timeout calls through pickup.c:dotip -> do_loot_cont -> tipcontainer -> removed_from_icebox.

The direct removed_from_icebox callers at pickup.c:2759, :3763, mon.c:1374 and muse.c:2355 are source-wired. The meatbox ICE_BOX arm is unreachable through its direct production consumers because ICE_BOX is TOOL_CLASS/PLASTIC and is neither organic nor metallic; scripts/pickup.test.mjs pins each caller gate.

The active muse.c:mloot_container caller remains runtime-incomplete. The retained C-first blocked recipe reaches a box pickup, but find_misc draws rn2(5)=1 at muse.c:2235, so MUSE_BAG is skipped and dog_invent drops the box before mloot_container. A single direction variation did not retain pickup and is excluded from passing recordings.
